Monetary Policy Report

Published 25 June 2026

Economic outlook

GDP is expected to grow by 1.3 per cent in 2026. Economic activity is gradually strengthening.

Inflation

CPIF inflation is expected to be 2.0 per cent in 2027. Inflation has fallen markedly from the peak.

The labour market

Unemployment is expected to be 7.2 per cent in 2026. Wage growth is expected to be 3.3 per cent in 2026.

Risks and uncertainty

The risks are tilted to the downside for economic activity in Sweden.

Monetary policy

Monetary policy needs to be tightened by a small amount in the coming year. The Executive Board will make its decisions on the basis of the assessment of the inflation outlook.
